entries.022889541a8f03f9: Sales of research reagents, equipment and other products for life science
entries.34a8cf5d87877ed0: These are general-purpose reagents such as antibodies, antigens, hormones and other biological substances, and medium additives, as well as applied reagents such as kits used in gene analysis and protein expression research, and kits for detecting and quantifying biological substances and environmental pollutants. By product, sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥8,558 million.
entries.512acc58675cb8a9: The group operates a single segment, and its main business is the purchase and sale of reagents, equipment and contract services for life science research. It handles products procured from domestic and overseas suppliers, its own developed and manufactured products, and contract services including drug discovery support. Consolidated subsidiary BM Kiki Co., Ltd. is an importer and trading company for equipment and consumables for life science research, and COSMO BIO USA, INC. sells reagents and equipment manufactured in Japan outside Japan and explores new suppliers in the United States. Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥10,766 million.
entries.5799b9466cc74920: Researchers at universities and other educational institutions
entries.7cfd610f9d3a74b2: These are research equipment and apparatus such as centrifuges, gene transfer devices, PCR devices, ultrasonic disruptors, and cell and gene manipulation equipment, and consumables such as pipette tips, PCR tubes, cell culture dishes and plates, and gloves. By product, sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥2,207 million.
entries.cb1a86ac1748ad2b: A company that purchases reagents and equipment for life science research from suppliers in Japan and overseas and sells them, and also develops and manufactures its own products and provides contract services.
